capabilities.name: Call log (inbound/outbound history)
capabilities.verify: list_voice_calls skill (db:voice_calls) + src/pages/admin/VoicePage.tsx 'all' tab table with direction/status/duration columns.

capabilities.name: WebRTC browser softphone (place/answer calls in-app)
capabilities.verify: src/components/admin/voice/Softphone.tsx exists and is wired into VoicePage.tsx 'softphone' tab, but no place_voice_call / answer_voice_call skill is exposed in VOICE_SKILLS (voice-module.ts) — only list/schedule/mark-callback.
capabilities.notes: UI-only surface; agents cannot place or answer a call over MCP, only manage post-call metadata (dual-surface law caps this at partial).

capabilities.name: Pluggable provider adapters (46elks, Twilio, ...)
capabilities.verify: src/lib/voice-providers listVoiceProviders() + capability matrix table in VoicePage.tsx (recording ✓ column per provider); useVoiceSettings/useUpdateVoiceSettings persists provider choice.

capabilities.name: Voicemail with greeting + transcription
capabilities.verify: VoicemailPanel.tsx + voicemailGreetingUrl setting + voice-recording edge function in VoicePage.tsx; list_voice_calls instructions mention 'transcript field is filled when voicemail is transcribed', but no dedicated MCP skill to fetch/act on a voicemail transcript directly (only via generic list).
capabilities.notes: Playback + greeting config are UI-only; transcript retrieval isn't a first-class skill.

capabilities.name: Missed-call queue / callback workflow
capabilities.verify: schedule_voice_callback + mark_voice_callback_done skills (rpc handlers) and 'missed'/'callbacks' tabs in VoicePage.tsx.

capabilities.name: Booking IVR (caller picks a callback slot / auto-book)
capabilities.verify: VoicePage.tsx has a setting 'automatically book the next free, non-conflicting slot' when missed call/voicemail comes in, referencing UC4 in schedule_voice_callback instructions ('Pair with the bookings module for UC4'), but no dedicated skill or IVR-menu builder UI is visible — behavior is a toggle, not a configurable flow.
capabilities.notes: Differentiator concept (Odoo VoIP has no booking-slot IVR) but currently a single on/off toggle, not a full IVR flow builder.

capabilities.name: Auto-SMS reply to missed calls/voicemail
capabilities.verify: VoicePage.tsx has 'Reply to voicemail by SMS' toggle (smsReplyEnabled) in settings, but no skill exposes sending/inspecting these SMS replies over MCP.

capabilities.name: AI receptionist fallback when no agent answers
capabilities.verify: VoicePage.tsx: 'Falls back to voicemail if Gemini is unavailable' and useIsGeminiConfigured hook gate an AI-receptionist setting, but no skillSeed lets an agent configure or query this from MCP.

capabilities.name: Call recording storage & retrieval
capabilities.verify: recording_url field + voice-recording edge function link in VoicePage.tsx CallRow, but list_voice_calls is the only skill and doesn't dedicate a fetch-recording action; relies on generic DB read.
capabilities.notes: Works via generic list, no dedicated recording-fetch skill with signed URL handling.

capabilities.name: Skill-based / round-robin agent routing queue
capabilities.verify: No queue/routing-rule table or UI found beyond per-agent voice config (AgentVoiceConfigCard.tsx handles individual agent settings, not a shared routing queue).
capabilities.notes: Odoo VoIP + call-center apps support ACD-style queues; FlowWink voice currently routes ad hoc.
